capex.detail: INR 1,800 crores planned for Ultravolt wires and cables business, with INR 1,100 crores spent or committed to date.
capex.timeline: balance to get spent in next 2 quarters
capex.quote: The investment of INR1,800 crores, which has been planned, we have spent around INR 1,100 crores till date and the balance will get spent in the next maybe 2 quarters.

capacity.detail: Commissioned 4.6 million tons of capacity in September, taking domestic cement capacity to 204.7 million tons.
capacity.quote: We commissioned 4.6 million tons of capacity in the month of September, taking our domestic cement capacity to 204.7 million tons...

mix.detail: Premium cement share is at 37% and blended cement share is at 67.3%.
mix.quote: 37% is my premium cement and blended cement would be 67.3%.

moat.detail: Large distribution network, wide geographical spread, and operating leverage from scale.
moat.quote: This is the operating leverage working for UltraTech as intended.

guidance.detail: On track to reach 240 million tons of capacity.
guidance.quote: We are on track to reach 240 million tons of capacity as planned without any surprises.

guidance.detail: Full year capex is estimated around INR 10,000 crores.
guidance.quote: I will still stick to INR 10,000, but it will be better to look at a full year number after the Q3 results. Plus minus INR10,000 crores.

catalysts.detail: Commissioned 116 megawatts of renewable power and 10 megawatt of waste heat recovery.
catalysts.quote: During the quarter, we also added 116 megawatts of renewable power, 10 megawatt of waste heat recovery.

risks.detail: Rising pet coke, fuel costs and industrial diesel prices due to West Asia crisis.
risks.quote: Pet coke prices have shot through the roof. They were trading around $180 per ton as I last checked.
